sourceNotes: All pairs come from three documents actually retrieved and read in full. (1) Eaton's official 'UL Classified Circuit Breaker Replacement Chart' (Eaton-branded, Type CL 1-in and Type CHQ 3/4-in classified solutions), retrieved from authorized distributor Rexel's CDN: https://rexel-cdn.com/products/breakers-classifedtype.pdf?i=7969BAC6-13FD-414A-B6C0-B48C72385185 — manufacturer cross, classed as manufacturer-cross despite distributor hosting. (2) Siemens Residential Product News bulletin RPPN-S3013 (Type QD), retrieved via Siemens' distributor-data syndication host: https://media.distributordatasolutions.com/siemenssi/2020q1/2bcea7e2ac2999ce0b76302a4f39f6e0065f1c7e.pdf. (3) DiversiTech part-number cross-reference Rev 10032016 (Rexel CDN) for the CH115/BR120 anchors — an industry cross sheet that itself disclaims direct replacement; both pairs carry that qualifier. UNRESOLVED — GE (ABB) THQL1115/THQL1120/THQL2130: eaton.com was unreachable from this client (repeated timeouts/connection failures via fetch and curl), so Eaton publication 5651B63 'Standard circuit breaker catalog numbers' — which per search-result snippets lists exact GE THQL1115–THQL1150 numbers against CL classified breakers — could not be retrieved; the retrievable Eaton chart prints the GE column in shorthand ('THQ1115/THQ1120') and Global's distributor catalog of Eaton CL classified breakers (https://s3.amazonaws.com/globalthesource/pdfcatalog/151/Circuit_Breakers_CL_Classified.pdf, retrieved) prints 'THQL115/THQL120/THQL230', so no pair was emitted at the exact THQL MPN level rather than risk a fabricated catalog number; corroborating language from that retrieved Global page: 'Classified Replacement Circuit Breakers are considered suitable, by Underwriters Laboratories, for use in another manufacturers' panel board.' UNRESOLVED — Siemens load centers SN3048B1200 and P4040B1200CU: no official cross/transition document was found in targeted searches; load centers are generally not crossed brand-to-brand, so no pair emitted. HOM120CP/HOM230CP suffix: Schneider's se.com product page (seen verbatim in search results: https://www.se.com/us/en/product/HOM120CP/mini-circuit-breaker-homeline-20a-1-pole-120-240vac-10ka-air-standard-type-plug-in-ul/) identifies HOM120CP as the Homeline 20 A 1-pole 120/240 VAC 10 kA plug-in breaker; the Eaton chart lists base numbers HOM120/HOM230 — the CP packaging-suffix mapping is flagged in pair notes for catalog QA. wesco.com was not fetched per instructions and no wesco.com brand URLs appeared in any search results. All classified-breaker relations were deliberately recorded as functional-substitute (not equivalent) because each source conditions the cross on UL classification terms limited to specific listed panels.

VERIFIED SOURCES ACTUALLY RETRIEVED: (1) ABB Empower eCatalog Competitor Lookup (official ABB manufacturer cross tool, https://empower.abb.com/ecatalog/ec/EN_NA/competitors/sub-detail/). I queried its public JSON endpoint (.../competitors/search/ajax?competitorName=&competitorCode=<PN>) directly over HTTPS and captured the raw responses, including ABB's own match-type ('Exact Match' vs 'Close Match') and comment fields, which are reproduced verbatim in evidence/notes. The cited ajax URLs return the data without authentication. (2) Multi-brand definite-purpose contactor CROSS REFERENCE LIST (Zettler / Siemens-Furnas / Products Unlimited / Square D / GE / Hartland Controls / Cutler-Hammer) hosted by distributor SupplyHouse.com; retrieved and text-extracted from https://s3.amazonaws.com/s3.supplyhouse.com/product_files/45FG20AG-cross%20reference.pdf (same file is served at s3.supplyhouse.com but that alias has a TLS cert mismatch, so the s3.amazonaws.com form is the working https URL). UNRESOLVED: LC1D32G7 — no entry in ABB's Competitor Lookup (queried LC1D32G7, LC1-D32G7, LC1D32; all empty) and no other official cross document could be retrieved for it; left out rather than inferred. AF09-30-10-13 as an anchor is covered as the B-side of two pairs (ABB's tool only maps competitor->ABB). TOOLS THAT BLOCKED SCRIPTED ACCESS: Schneider Electric cross-reference tool (tools.se.app/xref) — its AWS API (rj297lnzdk.execute-api.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/prd/competitordatafetch) returns {"message":"Error in login"} without a browser session; Eaton cross-reference tools (eaton.com/us/en-us/cross-reference-search.html and tools.eaton.com) timed out / refused connections; NOARK's cross-reference page is a JS app with no reachable static data. wesco.com was not fetched per instructions and no wesco.com brand URLs appeared verbatim in search results, so no wescoBrandUrl values are recorded. EXCLUDED LOWER-QUALITY LEADS: Kent Electrical Supply (kentstore.com) product-page FAQs state the Eaton XTCE009B10 is 'comparable' to Schneider LC1D09 and Siemens 3RT2015 (page fetched and verified) but explicitly say accessories are not interchangeable and it is an informal FAQ, not a cross table from a verified authorized distributor, so it was excluded; usbreaker.com and scribd cross PDFs were rejected as aftermarket/SEO-grade sources. Relation mapping: ABB 'Exact Match' -> equivalent; ABB 'Close Match' -> functional-substitute with ABB's qualifier captured in notes; row-aligned entries in the published DP cross list -> equivalent with verify-mounting caveats.

VERIFIED SOURCE USED (fetched and parsed in full): Hubbell Wiring Device-Kellems "Bin Stocking Cross Reference Guide" (2013), hosted on Hubbell's official CDN: https://hubbellcdn.com/ohwassets/HCI/WiringDevice/literature/BIN_Stock_Guide_2013.pdf. Table columns per section header: Description | Color | Fastenal # | Preferred Brand (Hubbell/Bryant) | Competitor Part Numbers: Arrow Hart, Cooper, Leviton, Pass & Seymour, Woodhead. The PDF was downloaded and text-extracted; a few cells overlap in extraction, and I flagged the two affected pairs (HBL5262↔P&S 5262-A and HBL5362W↔PS5362-W) in their notes. All seven emitted pairs anchor to our catalog MPNs HBL5262, HBL5362W, or CR20W.

OTHER OFFICIAL CROSS DOCUMENTS RETRIEVED BUT NOT USABLE FOR OUR ANCHORS: (1) Leviton "Lev-lok Modular Wiring Devices Competitive Cross Reference" Q-1185 (https://leviton.com/content/dam/leviton/commercial-industrial/product_documents/solution_sheets/Lev-lok_Competitive_Cross_Reference_Q-1185.pdf) — genuine Leviton-published brand-to-brand cross (e.g., Leviton M5262 ↔ Hubbell SNAP5262A ↔ P&S PT5262A ↔ Arrow Hart AH5262M), but it covers only modular Lev-lok/SNAP/PT part families; none of our 13 anchor MPNs appear, so no pairs were emitted from it. (2) Leviton "Dimmer Cross Reference Guide" (https://leviton.com/content/dam/leviton/residential/product_documents/user_guide-manual/Dimmer-Cross-Reference-Guide.pdf) — official Leviton-vs-Lutron cross, but it covers dimmers/fan controls only and does NOT include the Lutron Claro CA-1PS switch line.

UNRESOLVED ANCHORS (no official cross document naming them could be retrieved): Leviton 5325-W, T5325-W, GFNT2-W, 1221-2W, 1453-2W; Hubbell CS120W, HBL1221W; Pass & Seymour 3232W, PS20AC1-I; Lutron CA-1PS-WH. The official interactive cross tools that would answer these exist but are JavaScript-driven or block scripted access: Hubbell Competitor Part Cross Reference (https://www.hubbell.com/hubbell/en/part-cross-reference), Hubbell legacy eCross (hciapps.hubbell.com/hcipunchout/wiring/ecross.aspx — returned an application error), Leviton Manufacturer Cross Reference (https://leviton.com/manufacturer-cross-reference) and Leviton Quick Search (leviton.idea4industry.com — HTTP 403), Legrand Competitor Product Cross Reference (https://www.legrand.us/tools/product-cross-reference — results endpoint returned a server error), Eaton cross-reference search (eaton.com — interactive, states crosses are provided on a confidential basis). Distributor pages known to carry per-part crosses (onestopbuy.com, acdcusa.com) returned HTTP 403 to scripted fetch. A search snippet confirmed the Leviton 1221 ↔ P&S PS20AC1 ↔ Hubbell 1221 family cross exists (OneStopBuy listing for Leviton 1221-PLR citing P&S "PS 20 AC 1 RPL", Hubbell "1221 PL", Cooper "AH1221-PL"), but the snippet's MPNs are not in our catalog list, so per the anchoring rule no pair was emitted; a human with browser access to the Hubbell/Leviton/Legrand tools above could quickly resolve the remaining anchors. CAVEATS: the Hubbell guide is a 2013 edition assembled for a bin-stocking program (Fastenal); treat crosses as direct equivalents per the guide but re-verify discontinued/updated models (e.g., GFCI families have since changed to self-test designs). No wesco.com URLs were fetched and no wescoBrandUrl values were observed in search results.

All 9 pairs were verified on pages actually fetched and read in full. Primary sources: (1) Signify's official Advance ballast cross-reference guides hosted on assets.signify.com (GE-to-Advance PAd_1423CR and Osram-Motorola-to-Advance PAd_1430CR, both 09/19 editions, linked from signify.com/en-us/brands/advance/ballasts/cross-reference) - manufacturer competitive crosses, with Signify's standard no-warranty disclaimer; (2) Keystone Technologies' Quick Reference Guide cross-reference table (Keystone-authored catalog pages hosted on a Winsupply distributor PIM at pimmedia.winsupplyinc.com; a second edition of the same Keystone guide is hosted at assets.gordonelectricsupply.com and corroborates the same KTEB cross structure) - Keystone explicitly disclaims warranty of accuracy; (3) DigiKey TechForum obsolescence-replacement posts (authorized distributor) for the two Hatch LED-driver substitutes. UNRESOLVED (no official cross found, do not fabricate): Fulham WH2-120-C and WH5-120-L - Fulham publishes spec sheets (e.g. fulham.com/PDFs/SpecSheets/WH2-120-C-2006-43SP.pdf) listing supported lamp combinations but no published competitive cross table; fulham.com's 'Driver Cross Reference' page is a request form, not a table, and the only WorkHorse 'cross reference' pages found were SEO spam (rejected). Philips Advance XI040C110V054BST1 - ballastshop.com (fetched) confirms it is 'Discontinued by Manufacturer - Shipping Manufacturer's Exact Next Generation Replacement' but does not name the successor part number, so no pair is recorded; one unfetched search snippet suggested XI040C110V054B as the successor but this could not be verified on a retrieved page. Keystone's KTEB-232-UV-IS-N-P crosses to Advance IOP-2P32-SC (Optanium), not ICN-2P32-N (Centium) - no official document was found crossing KTEB-232-UV-IS-N-P directly to ICN-2P32-N, so that commonly-assumed pairing is intentionally omitted (Amazon/SEO listings asserting it were rejected). The Signify GE guide also crosses GE-232-MAX-N/ULTRA to IOP-2P32-N and GE-432-MAX-N/ULTRA to IOP-4P32-N, but those Advance IOP parts are not in our catalog list so they were not emitted as pairs. No wesco.com brand URLs appeared in any search results, so none were recorded. relation='equivalent' was used only where a manufacturer cross table presents a direct row-level cross; the two DigiKey obsolescence suggestions are marked functional-substitute per their 'possible alternative / verify datasheet' wording.
